title: Mastering Vertical Rhythm: Elevate UI Harmony and Readability with CSS Typography
tweet: Achieve pixel-perfect UI harmony! Learn how to implement vertical rhythm in your web designs using CSS typography to boost readability & user experience. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UserExperience
tip: To establish a consistent vertical rhythm, define a base line-height for your body text and ensure all other vertical measurements (margins, paddings, image heights) are multiples or fractions of this base. Using 'rem' units derived from a root 'font-size' that aligns with your line-height can create a robust, scalable system. This principle helps guide the user's eye naturally through content, significantly improving perceived order and readability.
